job.subcategory: Grief after losing a family member

persona.setting: lives in a PG with roommates

style_samples: I'm freaking out. I have my oral viva presentation for control systems tomorrow and I've been trembling all over, but especially my hands. It's gonna ruin my chance at getting a good placement, I know it.

Ugh, I just can't take it. I got that low grade on the project and now my GPA is suffering. This mid-semester is going to kill me, I have placements lined up and I need a good grade to stand a chance.

card: Lives in a PG with roommates
Guided breathing exercise did not help

turns.text: Aap, mujhe bilkul focus nahi ho raha. Dad ki death ke baad se sab kuch dim light lagta hai, aur exams sar pe hain.
Aap ke liye ye bahut heavy lag raha hai, especially dad ki loss ke baad. Koi aisa waqt tha jab aap thoda better feel kar rahi thi?
Kuch din pehle, roommate ne chai banayi thi aur hum thoda chat kiya tha, thoda calm feel hua.
Chai aur light conversation se aapko thoda relief mil gaya, ye achha sign hai. Kya aap aaj bhi koi aisi choti activity kar sakti hain?
Mujhe pata nahi, main soch rahi hoon ki koi music sunun ya thoda walk karun, lekin dim lag raha hai.
Aapke kamre ke bahar thodi tazgi mil sakti hai; 5‑minute ki choti walk aapke man ko shaant kar sakti hai. Kya aap agle study session ke baad ise try karna chahegi?
Haan, maybe. Par abhi sirf notes padh rahe hain, aur mind wander kar raha hai.
Jab dhyaan bhatak raha ho to padhna mushkil ho sakta hai. Thoda pause karke stretch karen aur paani ka ghoont lein, kya yeh aapko reset karega?
I can try that, thanks. Bas, abhi thoda anxious feel ho raha hai about the upcoming marketing test.
Test se pehle anxiety hona aam baat hai, khaas kar jab dukh ho. Kya aapne professor se thodi deadline extension ya guidance ke liye baat ki hai?
Nahi, I haven't. I fear they'll think I'm not serious.
Aap apni situation shanti se bata sakti hain; adhikansh professors personal loss ko samajhte hain. Kya ek chhota email bhejna aapke liye sambhav lagta hai?
